# Intentionally public names in this repository (identifier policy 2026-10-29;
# ci v1.27.0 syntax: key-scoped identifiers, exact text values, literal files).
#
# This repository IS the deployment configuration and is public on purpose
# (on-prem plan). rendered/ is GENERATED from values/ and platform/ and is
# proven current by chart-ci.yaml's "golden render is current" check
# (scripts/render.sh + git diff --exit-code rendered/) — it is not allowlisted
# at all: what its identifiers are is decided by these same entries, because
# a fresh render carries exactly what values/ and platform/ carry.
#
# Tier-2 ids (Entra tenant, app client ids) sit in `value:` scalars of
# deployment env blocks and in eso's `tenantId:` fields — suppressed ONLY
# there, by key scope. The Azure subscription id (tier 1) has no entry and
# no entry could suppress it: a hit means removal.
key:value
key:tenantId
